headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to define sex as only male or female, based on biology, in federal policy and records.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets a federal government policy that recognizes two sexes, male and female, based on biology. It tells federal agencies to use this definition in their rules, documents, and programs. No official summary was provided, so the specific details here are limited.

who_it_affects.how: Federal records, documents, and programs may recognize them only by the sex the government defines as biological, not by their gender identity.
Agencies are directed to apply this definition of sex in their policies, forms, and communications.
Groups that get federal money may need to follow the government's definition of sex in federally funded programs.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 20, 2025; executive orders generally take effect when signed, though agencies may carry out parts over time.
